Messages.Author: Sydnelson
Messages.Body:
I have updated lackeyccg with new 25th set.

If you already have LackeyCCG and VTES plugin installed just mark the option "Automatically check for plugins updates (if the plugin support it)?" under "Plugin" tab and LackeyCCG will update automatically every time a new version of plugin is released.

If you are new on LackeyCCG follow this tutorial:

How to install LackeyCCG:

1 - Download lackeyccg program from one of those URLs:

windows version
www.lackeyccg.com/LackeyCCGBetaWin.zip

mac/osx version
www.lackeyccg.com/LackeyCCGBetaMac.zip

linux version
www.lackeyccg.com/linux.html

ipad version
just install from apple store and jump to step 3

2 - Unzip it to a folder easy to remember.

3 - Open LackeyCCG.exe

4 - Go to "Plugin:war3000" tab and paste one of this two URLs:

for fast pc / high resolution screens
http://www.lackeyccg.com/vtes/high/updatelist.txt
OR

for slow pc / low resolution screens
http://www.lackeyccg.com/vtes/medium/updatelist.txt

5 - Click on "Install or Update from URL!" and wait until all files are downloaded.

6 - After download finish click on "load vtes plugin now!"
* if an error occurs or the above message not show try step 5 again.

Have a fun!

Tips:

To see your crypt face down cards on table just mouse over desired card and press shift.

To see shortcut bar with macro messages like Bleed, Hunt, Strike, just press +plus/-minus button above chat window.

If program ask for a update you just need to run lackey updater inside lackeyccg folder. This only updates the program, vtes game updates automatically every time a new version comes, but you can manually update it doing step 4 above again if you like.

To see your cards in left panel instead of bottom of game table or to see tokens menu or sound share tab just press +plus/-minus button on right top corner of program.

To see card images, just pass mouse over the card name and wait lackeyccg download it or if you want to download all images at once you need to go to: Preferences > Miscellaneous and tick the option "Allow pre-downloading images for offline use?" and click on "Download all missing card images" on Plugin:vtes tab. The entire card images package has between 150mb to 190mb depending on with version of plugin you have (high or low).

To convert decks from eld to lackeyccg format and vice-versa you can use feld2lackey.exe (windows only) program include in lackeyccg folder (only work with decks saved in txt format on lackeyccg).

If you or someone drop from game or if program crash you can back to game and request to previous turn player load a autosave by pressing "Revert to Autosave 1" in Main Menu.

To talk with other players using voice, you can use Skype program. Download skype from URL bellow and configure your account in Preferences > Player Profile. To create a group chat in Skype just press blue phone button in your avatar on left side of game tab (only works if another players also have setup theirs accounts on lackeyccg).

www.skype.com/en/download-skype/skype-for-computer

There is a Discord group of VTES players too.You can enter on that group following this link:
discord.gg/vMsr9EK

Note: I will update OCTGN in next weeks.
FELD 2.7.0 with Anthology database can be found  here .
